job.name: l1c_board_violet
job.meaning: полная дизайн-система для вертикальных обучающих роликов ритейла, палитра «Лаванда и персик»: глубокий фиолетовый, лаванда, персик, молочный; с новой Анной в этих же цветах и блоком из 5 разных раскладок вертикальных кадров
job.prompt: Create a complete design system board (brand style guide sheet) in the same FORMAT as the attached reference (blocks: hero, colour palette with HEX codes and meanings, typography, presenter style, graphic elements, icon style, infographic examples, decorative elements, footer principles) — but with a COMPLETELY NEW look; do NOT reuse the reference's colours, fonts or layout. All text in Russian, short and correctly spelled. Niche: short VERTICAL 9:16 training videos for retail store staff. Hero title: «Как принять возврат товара за 4 шага». Presenter: a NEW woman named Anna, about 30, store administrator, Russian/Slavic appearance, calm CONFIDENT expression with lips slightly parted (as if speaking), her clothes and the background behind her are in THIS palette (studio-like backdrop in the palette colours, not a warm wooden store), so the photo fits the graphics perfectly; she wears a name badge «Анна / Администратор». The SAME Anna appears everywhere on the board. IMPORTANT: a block «ВЕРТИКАЛЬНЫЕ КАДРЫ 9:16» with 5 phone-shaped frames showing FIVE DIFFERENT LAYOUTS: (1) presenter full frame with a big headline on top, (2) presenter cut out on the lower half with a step card above, (3) full-screen typography with a big number and no presenter, (4) split screen — presenter on one side, a checklist on the other, (5) presenter small in a round badge with a large infographic. Each layout uses the palette and shows one step of the return process (выслушать / проверить / оформить / вернуть). Palette: deep violet #2A1E5C, lavender #B9A7FF, peach #FFB38A, milk #FBF8F4, ink #16112E. Typography: «Unbounded SemiBold» headlines + «Golos Text» body. Mood: soft but confident, trendy.
